ladybug.notes: Top view facing up. Seven-pixel-wide domed shell: lady-red base, poppy-shade shadow crescent on the lower-left arc (rows 3-5) and a cream+blush specular cluster on the upper-right shoulder (rows 1-2) so the shell reads as a lit dome rather than a flat disc. Black ink head is a 3px nub at the top with the outline stepping out to a 5px pronotum; two ink spots sit off the mirror line (upper-left and lower-right) so they never read as eyes. Four 1px ink-warm legs at rows 2 and 4 plus two ink-warm rear feet on contact row 6; the four-frame scuttle lifts the front pair (frame 1), gathers the mid pair (frame 2) and steps the rear feet inboard (frame 3). No baked shadow.

ladybugFly.notes: Take-off pose, top-side, facing up. The elytra are parted: the lady-red shell reads as two domes split by the exposed ink-warm abdomen (2px seam widening to 4px at the rear), which is what sells the lifted shell. Wings are translucent pale membranes in wing (#d9ecdd) with foam (#c4e5ce) on the outer edge, so they stay legible over both the blue pond and the green banks; their leading edge is a broken ink line - dark only along the outer corner, with the rest of the edge left foam-pale so the wing never turns into a dark shape against the water. Wings sweep from the shoulders out to the cell corners (rows 0-3) and lift one row in the raised frame. The cream is a single specular on the shell's upper-right dome. Black head nub (2px at row 0, 4px at row 1) over the ink thorax; ink-warm legs on contact row 9. Airborne sprite: the engine may blend the last 1px of lift as a hover offset. No baked shadow.

ant.notes: Side view facing right. Three-part body reads by value and silhouette: ink-warm gaster at the left with a shadow-warm lit crown, a 2px notch at cols 2-3 above the single waist pixel at (3,2) and a shadow-warm 1x2 thorax, then the ink head at cols 5-6 with a single cream eye and two shadow-warm antennae on row 0. Legs are ink on rows 3-4 so the dark body still separates from them; the four frames alternate the leg diagonals (out, in, shifted, closed) for a quick scuttle. Antennae, waist pinch and the eye are the read-at-6x cues. No baked shadow.
